name: Antananarivo
subtitle: Antananarivo, capital of Madagascar: its numbers, a short history and places to see beyond the World Heritage list.

keyPoints.text: About 1,274,225 people live in Antananarivo Renivohitra district (counted 2018).
Andrianjaka became king of Merina in 1610 and ruled until 1630; he made Antananarivo the new capital.
Andrianjaka renamed the settlement Antananarivo to reflect the one thousand warriors stationed there.

parts.text: Andrianjaka became king of Merina in 1610 and ruled until 1630; he made Antananarivo the new capital.
Andrianjaka renamed the settlement Antananarivo to reflect the one thousand warriors stationed there.
The city was the capital established and named by Andrianjaka and became the capital of the Merina kingdom; it remains Madagascar's capital.
France annexed the kingdom of Imerina in 1896 (EBSCO also notes Madagascar officially became a French colony on 28 February 1897).

blocks.prompt: About how many people do you think live in Antananarivo Renivohitra district?

parts.text: 1,274,225 in 2018, according to the figures compiled from the national statistics office. Which area is counted matters: Census count (RGPH-3, 2018, final figures) for the district Antananarivo Renivohitra, which comprises Antananarivo city; listed as 'Urban'.

items.text: Andrianjaka becomes king of Merina and makes Antananarivo the new capital.
The Zoma, a large weekly open-air market in the heart of the city, is created by a powerful king.
The stone Andafiavaratra Palace, home of Prime Minister Rainilaiarivony, replaces the earlier wooden palace.
France annexes the kingdom of Imerina.
The Tsimbazaza botanical garden is created on 29 August 1925 by Governor General Marcel Olivier, initially 12 hectares.
A fire in the evening devastates the Rova of Antananarivo, destroying several historic buildings; no legal or administrative decision has identified who was responsible.
